title: Oil Spikes On Trump Comments, Markets Sell Hard But Bullish Setup Remains!
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.theme: Markets climbing a wall of worry
macro_themes.view: Bearish sentiment, oil, Iran, midterms, yields and France are all being absorbed; stay bullish until key supports break.
10y printed a daily topping tail at a 20-year high after strong auction demand and less-hawkish Fed minutes (no October hike).
Expects phenomenal earnings starting with banks next week, though sky-high expectations cap reactions (Samsung, TSMC).
Trump's anti-deal comments lifted oil only ~3.7%; markets are becoming immune to war headlines.

calls.reason: Only 0.5-1% off a new all-time high; double top resolving into a cup-and-handle breakout; bearish sentiment is fuel.
calls.quote: So I re I remain with a bullish bias on the S&P 500.

calls.condition: A daily plus weekly topping tail (needs selling to ~5.26-5.27% this week) would make it a very powerful top signal.
calls.reason: Daily topping tail at a 20-year high (5.365% high, ~5.286% close); with a weekly tail, >80% chance of further downside in coming days and weeks.
calls.quote: Probably over 80% chance that yields will have more further downside in the coming days and weeks.

calls.condition: A daily close below ~88.75 would send oil 'much, much lower' (prior target $78).
calls.reason: Oil held its trend line Tue/Wed, then popped on Trump comments; trend line is the level to watch.
calls.quote: If we break basically below 8875 on a daily closing basis... oil should go much, much lower.

calls.condition: Break above the 3.18-3.19 trend line opens 3.33 and potentially a much bigger move.
calls.reason: Five straight up days into a multi-touch resistance trend line; took half profits, holding half for a bigger breakout.
calls.quote: If we can break above this 318, 319 area, we then easily test 333

calls.condition: Breakdown confirmed by a close below yesterday's low; bulls need a daily close back above the orange trend line.
calls.reason: Closed below key trend line but needs confirmation; pivotal level, resolution within a few days.
calls.quote: We probably know within the next few trading days, is this a breakdown or are we going to see a bigger bounce in gold?

calls.condition: If it closes below the ascending trend line and confirms the next day, targets 55 then 50.
calls.reason: Silver weaker, borderline breaking its ascending trend line.
calls.quote: If it's a real breakdown, you're going to 55, then you're going to 50.

calls.condition: Break above 87,200 targets 95-97k; break below 81,000 targets 75,500.
calls.reason: Price between his two key levels; not in a swing trade either way.
calls.quote: If we break this probability spikes that we will go to 95 to 97,000. If we break below 81,000... a move down to where? To …

calls.condition: A break above ~$400 channel resistance would be a breakout.
calls.reason: Still trading within a parallel channel.
calls.quote: If it surges up, there will be some resistance around $400. That's going to be a breakout line

calls.condition: Only if TSM fills the gap at 459 today (day-trade scalp).
calls.reason: Strong preliminary revenue but stock slightly down; gap fill would be a high-probability intraday scalp.
calls.quote: if we were to fill this gap today at 459, I actually would consider a day trade scalp.

notes: Date: references 'the Fed minutes' yesterday and 'on Tuesday' oil test, i.e. Thursday 2026-10-08 (matches listing). Natural-gas levels quoted as '318, 319' and '333' interpreted as $3.18-3.19 and $3.33 (NG is not in the canonical list; ticker 'NG'). Oil '8875' = $88.75. TNX price_at_call is approximate (~5.29-5.30%, yesterday's close 5.286%). PEP earnings discussed but no call.
